abstract: BACKGROUND: Although much is known about the morphologic, cytogenetic, and clinical characters of gestational trophoblastic diseases, little information has appeared concerning the parameters related to their persistence or neoplastic transformation. Cell cycle alterations in tumor tissue were examined in this study in light of obvious changes in the clinical behavior of malignant cells. There is an increasing body of evidence suggesting that the abnormal expression of cyclins is considered one of the most important events in malignant transformation of various human cancers. Among these cell cycle regulators, the role of cyclin E in the neoplastic transformation of trophoblast populations has been poorly defined. METHODS: Using formalin fixed, paraffin embedded trophoblastic tissues, the authors investigated the expression of cyclin E by immunohistochemistry in placentas with hydropic change and gestational trophoblastic diseases. The specimens examined included tissue from 29 patients with complete hydatidiform mole, 18 patients with partial hydatidiform mole, and 6 patients with choriocarcinoma after term pregnancy or abortion. The authors also studied four cases of hydropic abortion. RESULTS: The cyclin E indexes (CEI) were as follows: 25.7% +/- 6.2% for hydropic change, 35.3% +/- 12.7% for triploid partial moles, 42.2% +/- 13.1% for diploid/tetraploid complete moles, and 63.6% +/- 9.5% for choriocarcinomas. There was a significant difference in CEI between placentas with hydropic change and partial mole (P = 0.04) and placentas with hydropic change and complete mole (P = 0.003). Choriocarcinomas had significantly higher cyclin E expression compared with placentas, partial moles, and complete moles, respectively. A significant correlation between the expression of cyclin E and S-phase fraction was observed in gestational trophoblastic diseases (rank correlation coefficient = 0.45, P < 0. 05). The relation between cyclin E expression and proliferation was abrogated in placentas with hydropic change, suggesting that cyclin E up-regulation represents a genuine aberration. CONCLUSIONS: The results of this study were consistent with the concept that cyclin E overaccumulation may play an important role in the uncontrolled proliferation and neoplastic transformation of trophoblasts.
abstract_ja: 背景：妊娠性絨毛性疾患の性質や持続、腫瘍化に関する情報は限られている。本研究では、悪性腫瘍の臨床的挙動の変化を踏まえ、腫瘍組織の細胞周期異常を検討した。多くのヒト癌では、サイクリンの異常発現が悪性転化における最も重要な事象の一つと考えられている。これら細胞周期調節因子のうち、栄養膜細胞の腫瘍化におけるサイクリンEの役割は十分に解明されていない。方法：ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋の栄養膜組織を用い、水腫性変化の胎盤および妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるサイクリンEの発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。対象は完全胞状奇胎29例、部分胞状奇胎18例、妊娠成立後または流産後の絨毛癌6例、水腫性流産4例である。結果：サイクリンE指数(CEI)は、水腫性変化25.7%±6.2%、三倍体部分奇胎35.3%±12.7%、二倍体/四倍体完全奇胎42.2%±13.1%、絨毛癌63.6%±9.5%であった。水腫性変化の胎盤と部分奇胎（P=0.04）、水腫性変化の胎盤と完全奇胎（P=0.003）の間にはCEIの有意差があった。絨毛癌は胎盤、部分奇胎、完全奇胎のいずれと比べてもサイクリンE発現が有意に高かった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患ではサイクリンE発現とS期分画との間に有意な相関を認めた（順位相関係数=0.45、P<0.05）。水腫性変化の胎盤では、サイクリンE発現と増殖との関係が消失しており、サイクリンEの高発現は真の異常であることが示唆された。結論：本研究の結果は、サイクリンEの過剰蓄積が栄養膜細胞の制御されない増殖と腫瘍化に重要な役割を果たしうるという考えと一致した。
